settings.title: Your Discovery Experience
settings.text: Each blend embodies a unique personality. Talk to them, learn their lore, and find the perfect flavor match for your palate.

settings.title: Retro, But Refined
settings.text: We channel early-2000s vibes with modern roasting, careful quality control, and clean design. Nostalgia that actually tastes good.

settings.title: Community First
settings.text: From collabs to fan art, Captain Coffee is built with (and for) our community. Ohana means family, and family means every customer.

settings.title: Ethical Sourcing
settings.text: Great coffee starts at the source. We focus on fair partnerships and traceable beans, so every cup does right by the people who grew it.

settings.name: Kayla
settings.bio: The brilliant backbone of Captain Coffee — turning big ideas into crisp operations and keeping the ship steady through every storm.

settings.name: Mark
settings.bio: The adventurous dreamer behind our blends and characters — thinks in quests, designs with nostalgia, and ships with precision.

settings.name: Alex
settings.bio: Sharp-witted innovator dialing in flavor and feel — the spark of youth: bold, clever, and just a little bit subversive.

settings.heading: JOIN THE OHANA
settings.text: Every hero needs a good origin story, and yours starts with a great cup. Grab a blend, join the Captains Crew, and become part of the family.
